quizName:
Sign Test
									  					
									  														  					Check how well you know road signs.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash means you cannot do something. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. Be careful and slow down when you see this sign.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The overpass ahead is too low.
Two lanes of traffic are about to merge.

questions.correctAnswerText: The overpass ahead is too low.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a low overpass. Do not continue if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the road.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road curves sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show the direction of a sharp curve. The arrow points in the direction the road will turn. Multiple signs may be used along the curve.

questions.question: What does a green arrow on a lane control signal mean?

options.text: No traffic is allowed in this lane.
You must merge into this lane.

questions.explanation: A steady green arrow pointing down means you can use that lane.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a divided highway is starting. The road splits into two separate one-way roads. Stay on the right side.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you about a low overpass. Do not continue if your vehicle is taller than the height shown (13 feet 6 inches in this case).

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead curves only to the right.
The road ahead turns sharply to the right.
The road ahead curves to the right, then to the left.
The road ahead curves to the left, then to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead curves to the right, then to the left.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns drivers that the road will curve to the right first, then to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with yellow background and black markings. This sign warns you to drive carefully when the road is wet because it may be slippery and hard to control.

questions.question: A sign with this shape and color is a ____ sign.
questions.explanation: Pennant-shaped signs are only used for no passing zones.

questions.question: What do these signs mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for road hazards. These object markers warn drivers about dangerous objects or areas to avoid.

questions.question: What can you do from the center lane?
questions.explanation: This lane is only for left-turning vehicles from either direction. You cannot use it for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that U-turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers what they must and must not do. It means you cannot make a left turn.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Follow the detour to the right.
Get ready to enter a one-way street.
Stay on the main highway if you can.
Follow the detour to the right only if it is convenient.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour to the right.
questions.explanation: Work area signs are orange with black letters or symbols. Detour signs show you an alternate route around a road that is blocked by construction.

questions.question: What does this sign tell you?

options.text: Trucks are not allowed on an upcoming hill.
Trucks are on an upcoming hill.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill or steep downgrade is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead. Be ready to turn right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that cattle may cross the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you that an intersection is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: A lane is ending or the road is narrowing ahead.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. This sign warns you that the right lane is ending or the road is getting narrower.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Keep your speed the same until you reach the reduced speed zone.
Do not slow down because traffic will back up.
You can reduce your speed if you want to.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you to start reducing your speed. The new speed limit will begin at the next speed limit sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must drive at exactly this speed.
The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
You must drive through the intersection at this speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The highest legal speed on this road is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This is a speed limit sign. It shows the maximum speed you can drive on this road. In bad weather or poor conditions, you may need to drive slower than the posted speed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic is merging in from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic is merging in from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that traffic will be entering the road from the right side.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to dangers ahead. This sign warns you that buggies may be on the road.

questions.question: What should you do when you see this sign?

options.text: Slow down and let trains pass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let trains pass.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you of a railroad crossing ahead. Always slow down when approaching railroad tracks. Trains cannot stop for cars, so you must wait for the train to pass before crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange signs warn drivers about construction zones. This sign tells you the right lane will be closed due to construction work. Be careful in construction areas.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must stop for workers with flags.
The road is closed to all traffic.

questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers of work zones. This sign tells you that construction or maintenance work is ahead. Slow down and drive carefully.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: No right turn on red light.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn on red light.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you what you must do. It is posted at traffic lights where turning right on red is not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A school is near or children may cross here.

questions.correctAnswerText: A school is near or children may cross here.
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn you about schools. Be alert for children and pedestrians. This sign marks a school crossing or school zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow and black warning signs alert you to road conditions ahead. This sign tells you a lane is ending. Prepare to let traffic merge safely.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a four-way intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road hazards. This sign tells drivers that a stop sign is coming and they should get ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare drivers for upcoming road hazards. This sign tells drivers that lanes are shifting and they should follow the new lane path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
Your road intersects with a divided highway ahead.
You are driving over a divided highway on an overpass.

questions.correctAnswerText: Your road intersects with a divided highway ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign means your road will intersect with a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Highway changes ahead and to the right.
Hiking trails ahead and to the right.
Hotel ahead and to the right.
Hospital ahead and to the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: Hospital ahead and to the right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that a hospital with emergency services is to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must or must not do. This sign means parking is not allowed.

questions.question: This sign warns that you are approaching:
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a railroad crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a steep downhill grade is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must or must not do. This sign tells drivers to stay in the right lane to avoid a hazard ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns drivers that a traffic signal is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign show?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a flagger is controlling traffic ahead in a construction area.

questions.question: What is the main danger shown by this sign?

options.text: Your headlights may not work properly if your car tilts to one side.
Your tire may be damaged if you drift onto the shoulder.
Your car may hydroplane if the shoulder is wet.
You may lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: You may lose control of your vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the shoulder is lower than the road. If one wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not slam the brakes or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control. Instead, ease back onto the road gently.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road hazards ahead. This sign warns you of an upcoming curve in the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: A one-way sign shows the only legal direction traffic can flow on that road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign warns you to watch for people crossing the road.

questions.question: What does a posted speed limit show?

options.text: The exact speed you must drive to avoid a ticket.
The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
The maximum safe speed in all conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum safe speed under good road and weather conditions.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the highest legal speed for that road in ideal conditions. When weather is bad or roads are wet, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road ahead has many curves or turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a low railroad crossing. The tracks cross the road at a steep angle. The bottom of low vehicles may drag or get stuck on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a school crossing is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You must turn right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must turn right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign prohibits U-turns. Do not make a U-turn where you see this sign.

questions.question: At a school crossing sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop, even if there is no stop sign.
Watch for children and be ready to stop.
Always honk your horn when you see children.
Be ready to help children cross the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: Watch for children and be ready to stop.
questions.explanation: You must let pedestrians cross first. Pay attention to pedestrians at intersections and when turning.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot enter this road or driveway from this direction. Turn around and go a different way.

questions.question: When you see this sign, what must you do?

options.text: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and traffic.
Stop completely and wait for a green light.
Slow down and check for traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Stop completely and look for pedestrians and traffic.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign is a stop sign. You must stop completely and check for pedestrians and traffic. Wait until the intersection is clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign tells you a playground is near. Watch for children on or near the road.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Cars in right lane must slow down.
Pass only in the right lane.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that two lanes of traffic going the same direction will soon become one lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. This sign warns you the road has many curves. Slow down and be careful.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means there are multiple left turn lanes. Drivers in the far left lane must turn left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is posted at the end of one-way streets. It warns drivers not to enter a roadway from the wrong direction. When you see this sign, stop and turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign tells drivers that traffic may enter the road from a side road ahead. Watch for vehicles joining your road.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a T intersection is ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
When turning left on a green light, yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: When turning left on a green light, yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign works with a traffic signal. It tells drivers turning left that they do not have the right-of-way. You must wait for oncoming traffic to pass before turning.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
The road ahead has a series of curves.

questions.correctAnswerText: Reduce your speed when the pavement is wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the pavement is slippery when wet. Slow down, avoid sudden braking or sharp turns, and keep a larger distance between your vehicle and the one in front of you.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the divided highway is ending ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Construction zones are dangerous for both drivers and construction workers. This orange sign tells drivers that penalties and fines are increased if you drive unsafely in a work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers to wait for a left turn signal before turning left. Only turn left when the signal indicates it is safe.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers in the left lane that they must turn left. You cannot go straight ahead in this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a nearby fire station. Watch for emergency vehicles that may be entering or leaving the road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Five-sided signs warn you that a school is nearby. Watch for children and people crossing the road. You must follow any directions given by a crossing guard.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign tells you a detour is coming in 1,000 feet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a bridge with narrow lanes is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They tell you about road conditions and hazards ahead. This sign warns you that an area with low clearance is coming up.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn you to be careful around construction zones. This sign tells you that construction ahead will change your normal route. Be ready to drive on a redirected path.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Construction workers on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign tells you that people may be crossing the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
Stop completely and give other traffic the right-of-way.
Slow down, be ready to stop, and let other traffic pass if needed.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be ready to stop, and let other traffic pass if needed.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down as you reach the intersection and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, or pedestrians pass safely before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a divided highway is coming up.

questions.question: What does a yellow and black diamond-shaped sign tell you?

options.text: It warns you about conditions on or near the road.
It helps direct you to cities and towns ahead.
It tells you about traffic laws and rules.
It tells you about road construction ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: It warns you about conditions on or near the road.
questions.explanation: Warning signs are diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn you about road conditions and hazards ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that bicycles may be on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in this direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must come to a complete stop.
Drive with caution and be ready to stop.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must come to a complete stop.
questions.explanation: An eight-sided sign always means stop. You must come to a complete stop and wait for vehicles and pedestrians to clear before you go.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually diamond-shaped with black markings on a yellow background. They warn you about hazards ahead. This sign warns you that a traffic light is coming, so be ready for a yellow or red light.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is a 35 mph speed zone after the curve ahead.
Drive no less than 35 mph around the curve ahead.
Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.
Stay in the right-hand lane if not driving over 35 mph.

questions.correctAnswerText: Curve ahead, speeds of 35 mph or slower are recommended.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are usually yellow with black markings. They alert you to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that bicycles may be crossing.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep hill is coming.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The maximum safe speed for a residential area.
The maximum safe speed for an expressway exit.

The maximum safe speed for a work zone.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for people working on or near the roadway.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that workers are on or near the road. Drive slowly and carefully in work zones.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Don't drink if you are going to drive.

questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road becomes slippery when it rains.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you the road ahead curves to the right.

options.text: A series of curves is ahead.

options.text: You are about to enter a one-way street from the wrong direction.

options.text: Trucks are permitted on an upcoming narrow bridge.

options.text: Change lanes if safe to let traffic merge.

questions.explanation: Make room for vehicles entering your road. If no one is next to you, move to another lane.

options.text: The road curves left, then right.
The road curves right, then left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road curves right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the road curves right and then left. Slow down to safely navigate these curves.

questions.question: This is a ____ sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Slow down if cars are approaching.
Come to a full stop. Go when it is safe.
Stop only for traffic on crossing roads.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a full stop. Go when it is safe.

options.text: Loose gravel on the road ahead.
Road has been sanded for ice.

options.text: There is a bus stop ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The minimum speed limit is 40 mph.

options.text: The road curves right ahead. Slow down to 35 mph.

questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road will curve to the right. Slow down to the safe speed shown on the sign (35 mph in this case).

questions.question: A driver's left arm and hand point upward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver's left arm and hand point upward, it means the driver plans to turn right. If you see this signal, adjust your driving accordingly.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign alerts you that an extra lane is being added to the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that the road becomes slippery when it rains or is wet.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that there is a sharp right turn coming up on the road ahead.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side shown by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This is a "Keep right" sign. It tells you that there is a traffic island, median, or barrier ahead. You must keep to the right side of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This is a warning sign. Warning signs are yellow with black markings. This sign tells you that the road will soon become a divided highway.

questions.question: What does this sign prevent?

options.text: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entering one-way streets and expressway ramps from the wrong direction.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way. You cannot enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers about construction zones ahead. This sign tells you a flagger is ahead. Follow their directions.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: Be prepared for a sharp left turn ahead.
Watch for people crossing your path.
Follow the detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.

questions.correctAnswerText: Follow the detour to avoid dangerous driving conditions.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that traffic patterns have changed due to a work zone. Follow the marked detour.

questions.question: If you see this sign above your lane, what must you do?

options.text: You may not exit the freeway.
You may continue through or exit from your current lane.
You may stay in your lane and continue through.
You must exit if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must exit if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means this lane leads off the road to an exit ramp. You must either change lanes or exit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive slowly and sound your horn.
You are entering a school parking lot.

questions.explanation: Yellow warning signs alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign tells you a school zone is coming. Slow down and watch for children.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with the flow of traffic.
Limit your speed for the next 50 miles.
Speed limits are enforced for the next 50 miles.
The maximum speed is 50 miles per hour.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum speed is 50 miles per hour.
questions.explanation: A speed limit sign shows the maximum safe speed allowed on that road.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass only at night.

questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. It means passing is prohibited in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Yellow diamond warning signs alert drivers to hazards. This sign tells you the divided highway is ending.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: The road turns sharply right, then left.
The road turns sharply left, then right.
The road curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will make a sharp right turn followed by a sharp left turn.

questions.question: The driver's left arm is extended downward. What does this hand signal mean?
questions.explanation: When a driver extends their left arm downward, they are signaling that they plan to stop. Adjust your driving if you see this signal.

questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers that the right lane will end ahead. Drivers in the right lane must move to the left lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign marks reserved parking spaces in parking lots. These spaces are for vehicles with a handicap sticker, tag, or license plate.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns that two-way traffic is coming ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers they can either turn right or continue straight from this lane at an intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells drivers that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: When you see a yield sign, you should:

options.text: Always stop before entering the intersection.
Only yield to traffic on the right.
Only yield to traffic on the left.
Slow down and let other traffic go first.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down and let other traffic go first.
questions.explanation: A yield sign means you must slow down and let traffic already in the intersection or on the road you are entering go first.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic light ahead is red.
The traffic light ahead is broken.
The traffic light ahead is green.

questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Orange construction signs warn drivers to be careful. This sign tells drivers to follow a different route because of roadwork ahead.

options.text: A community group is cleaning the highway ahead.

options.text: The left lane is for vehicles with a minimum number of people.

questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. Only buses and cars with the driver plus one or more passengers can use this lane.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you about hazards ahead. A flagger will be directing traffic. Follow the flagger's directions.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means the road ahead is now divided. Stay to the right of the divider or median.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This orange construction sign warns you of work crews on or near the road. Drive with extra caution.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They prepare you for upcoming hazards. This sign warns you to watch for dangers ahead and be prepared to stop.

The road ahead turns sharply. Slow down.
